1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Atomic HTTP/3 -> HTTP/1.1 translation bridge (offline synthetic fixtures).
     3	
     4	Reads one JSON scenario on stdin, writes one JSON audit ledger on stdout.
     5	Field strings and ledger strings denote Latin-1 octets (U+0000..U+00FF).
     6	"""
     7	
     8	import ipaddress
     9	import json
    10	import re
    11	import sys
    12	
    13	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    14	# deployment policy tables
    15	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16	
    17	METHODS = frozenset((b"GET", b"HEAD", b"POST", b"PUT", b"PATCH", b"DELETE",
    18	                     b"OPTIONS"))
    19	SCHEMES = frozenset((b"http", b"https"))
    20	DEFAULT_PORT = {"http": 80, "https": 443}
    21	
    22	# initial regular fields that may never appear
    23	PROHIBITED = frozenset((
    24	    b"connection", b"proxy-connection", b"keep-alive", b"transfer-encoding",
    25	    b"upgrade", b"http2-settings", b"trailer"))
    26	
    27	# initial regular fields that may repeat as separate lines
    28	REPEATABLE = frozenset((
    29	    b"accept", b"accept-encoding", b"cache-control", b"if-match",
    30	    b"if-none-match", b"pragma", b"vary"))
    31	
    32	PSEUDO = frozenset((b":method", b":scheme", b":authority", b":path"))
    33	
    34	MAX_SECTION_SIZE = 8192
    35	MAX_CONTENT = 65536
    36	
    37	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    38	# octet-shaped grammar
    39	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    40	
    41	NAME_RE = re.compile(rb"[a-z0-9!#$%&'*+\-.^_`|~]+\Z")
    42	VALUE_RE = re.compile(rb"[\x21-\x7e\x80-\xff]"
    43	                      rb"(?:[\t\x20\x21-\x7e\x80-\xff]*[\x21-\x7e\x80-\xff])?\Z")
    44	PATH_RE = re.compile(rb"/(?:[a-zA-Z0-9\-._~!$&'()*+,;=:@/?]|%[0-9a-fA-F]{2})*\Z")
    45	DNS_LABEL_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-zA-Z](?:[0-9a-zA-Z-]{0,61}[0-9a-zA-Z])?\Z")
    46	PORT_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{1,5}\Z")
    47	CL_MEMBER_RE = re.compile(rb"[0-9]+\Z")
    48	def name_ok(name):
    49	    """Regular field name: nonempty, lowercase letters/digits/punctuation."""
    50	    if not name:
    51	        return False
    52	    return NAME_RE.match(name) is not None
    53	
    54	
    55	def value_ok(value):
    56	    """Empty, or visible-octet edges with SP/HTAB allowed only inside."""
    57	    if not value:
    58	        return True
    59	    return VALUE_RE.match(value) is not None
    60	
    61	
    62	def path_ok(path, method):
    63	    if path == b"*":
    64	        return method == b"OPTIONS"
    65	    if not path.startswith(b"/") or path[1:2] == b"/":
    66	        return False
    67	    return PATH_RE.match(path) is not None
    68	
    69	
    70	def digits_norm(member):
    71	    stripped = member.lstrip(b"0")
    72	    return stripped if stripped else b"0"
    73	
    74	
    75	def content_length_ok(lines):
    76	    """Return True when every comma member denotes the same integer."""
    77	    wanted = None
    78	    for line in lines:
    79	        for member in line.split(b","):
    80	            member = member.strip(b" \t")
    81	            if not member or CL_MEMBER_RE.match(member) is None:
    82	                return None
    83	            norm = digits_norm(member)
    84	            if wanted is None:
    85	                wanted = norm
    86	            elif norm != wanted:
    87	                return None
    88	    return wanted
    89	
    90	
    91	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    92	# authority canonicalisation
    93	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    94	
    95	def port_ok(text):
    96	    if PORT_RE.match(text) is None:
    97	        return None
    98	    value = int(text)
    99	    if value < 1 or value > 65535:
   100	        return None
   101	    return value
   102	
   103	
   104	def dns_host_ok(text):
   105	    """Return lowercased DNS name, or None."""
   106	    if len(text) < 1 or len(text) > 253:
   107	        return None
   108	    labels = text.split(".")
   109	    if len(labels) == 4:
   110	        quad = True
   111	        for label in labels:
   112	            if not label:
   113	                quad = False
   114	                break
   115	            for ch in label:
   116	                if ch < "0" or ch > "9":
   117	                    quad = False
   118	                    break
   119	            if not quad:
   120	                break
   121	        if quad:
   122	            for label in labels:
   123	                if len(label) > 1 and label[0] == "0":
   124	                    return None
   125	                if int(label) > 255:
   126	                    return None
   127	            return ".".join(str(int(label)) for label in labels)
   128	    for label in labels:
   129	        if not label or not label.isascii():
   130	            return None
   131	        if DNS_LABEL_RE.match(label) is None:
   132	            return None
   133	    return text.lower()
   134	
   135	
   136	def authority_canonical(raw, scheme):
   137	    """Canonical authority string for Latin-1 octets, or None."""
   138	    try:
   139	        text = raw.decode("latin-1")
   140	    except UnicodeDecodeError:
   141	        return None
   142	    port = None
   143	    if text.startswith("["):
   144	        end = text.find("]")
   145	        if end < 0:
   146	            return None
   147	        inner = text[1:end]
   148	        rest = text[end + 1:]
   149	        if "%" in inner or "%" in rest:
   150	            return None
   151	        if rest:
   152	            if not rest.startswith(":"):
   153	                return None
   154	            port = port_ok(rest[1:])
   155	            if port is None:
   156	                return None
   157	        if not inner or not inner.isascii():
   158	            return None
   159	        try:
   160	            host = "[" + ipaddress.IPv6Address(inner).compressed + "]"
   161	        except ValueError:
   162	            return None
   163	    else:
   164	        cut = text.find(":")
   165	        if cut >= 0:
   166	            port = port_ok(text[cut + 1:])
   167	            if port is None:
   168	                return None
   169	            hostpart = text[:cut]
   170	        else:
   171	            hostpart = text
   172	        if not hostpart or not hostpart.isascii():
   173	            return None
   174	        host = dns_host_ok(hostpart)
   175	        if host is None:
   176	            return None
   177	    if port is not None and port != DEFAULT_PORT[scheme]:
   178	        host = host + ":" + str(port)
   179	    return host
   180	
   181	
   182	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   183	# per-section parsing
   184	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   185	
   186	def section_size(pairs):
   187	    total = 0
   188	    for name, value in pairs:
   189	        total += len(name) + len(value) + 32
   190	    return total
   191	
   192	
   193	def parse_initial(pairs):
   194	    """Validate initial HEADERS; return summary dict or None."""
   195	    if section_size(pairs) > MAX_SECTION_SIZE:
   196	        return None
   197	    seen_pseudo = set()
   198	    method = scheme = path = authority = host = None
   199	    regular = []
   200	    past_regular = False
   201	    for name, value in pairs:
   202	        if name[:1] == b":":
   203	            if past_regular or name not in PSEUDO or name in seen_pseudo:
   204	                return None
   205	            seen_pseudo.add(name)
   206	            if not value_ok(value):
   207	                return None
   208	            if name == b":method":
   209	                if method is not None:
   210	                    return None
   211	                method = value
   212	            elif name == b":scheme":
   213	                if scheme is not None:
   214	                    return None
   215	                scheme = value
   216	            elif name == b":path":
   217	                if path is not None:
   218	                    return None
   219	                path = value
   220	            else:
   221	                if authority is not None:
   222	                    return None
   223	                authority = value
   224	            continue
   225	        if not name_ok(name) or not value_ok(value):
   226	            return None
   227	        past_regular = True
   228	        if name == b"host":
   229	            if host is not None:
   230	                return None
   231	            host = value
   232	        else:
   233	            regular.append((name, value))
   234	
   235	    if method is None or scheme is None or path is None:
   236	        return None
   237	    if method not in METHODS or scheme not in SCHEMES:
   238	        return None
   239	    if not path_ok(path, method):
   240	        return None
   241	
   242	    if authority is None and host is None:
   243	        return None
   244	    if authority is not None:
   245	        if not authority:
   246	            return None
   247	        if host is not None and host != authority:
   248	            return None
   249	    elif not host:
   250	        return None
   251	    chosen = authority if authority is not None else host
   252	
   253	    scheme_text = scheme.decode("ascii")
   254	    canon = authority_canonical(chosen, scheme_text)
   255	    if canon is None:
   256	        return None
   257	
   258	    counts = {}
   259	    for name, _value in regular:
   260	        counts[name] = counts.get(name, 0) + 1
   261	    for name in counts:
   262	        if name in PROHIBITED:
   263	            return None
   264	
   265	    te_lines = [value for name, value in regular if name == b"te"]
   266	    if len(te_lines) > 1 or (te_lines and te_lines[0] != b"trailers"):
   267	        return None
   268	
   269	    cl_lines = [value for name, value in regular if name == b"content-length"]
   270	    cl = None
   271	    if cl_lines:
   272	        cl = content_length_ok(cl_lines)
   273	        if cl is None:
   274	            return None
   275	
   276	    for name, count in counts.items():
   277	        if count == 1:
   278	            continue
   279	        if name in REPEATABLE or name in (b"cookie", b"content-length"):
   280	            continue
   281	        if name.startswith(b"x-list-") and len(name) > 7:
   282	            continue
   283	        return None
   284	
   285	    cookie_values = [value for name, value in regular if name == b"cookie"]
   286	    return {
   287	        "method": method,
   288	        "scheme": scheme_text,
   289	        "path": path,
   290	        "canon": canon,
   291	        "regular": regular,
   292	        "cookie_values": cookie_values,
   293	        "cl": cl,
   294	    }
   295	
   296	
   297	def parse_trailers(pairs):
   298	    if section_size(pairs) > MAX_SECTION_SIZE:
   299	        return None
   300	    for name, value in pairs:
   301	        if not name_ok(name) or not value_ok(value):
   302	            return None
   303	        if not name.startswith(b"x-audit-") or len(name) <= 8:
   304	            return None
   305	    return True
   306	
   307	
   308	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   309	# serialization
   310	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   311	
   312	def serialize(summary, content, trailers):
   313	    out = bytearray()
   314	    out += summary["method"]
   315	    out += b" "
   316	    out += summary["path"]
   317	    out += b" HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: "
   318	    out += summary["canon"].encode("latin-1")
   319	    out += b"\r\n"
   320	
   321	    cookie_values = summary["cookie_values"]
   322	    joined = b"; ".join(cookie_values) if cookie_values else b""
   323	    emitted_cookie = False
   324	    for name, value in summary["regular"]:
   325	        if name == b"content-length" or name == b"te":
   326	            continue
   327	        if name == b"cookie":
   328	            if not emitted_cookie:
   329	                emitted_cookie = True
   330	                out += b"cookie: "
   331	                out += joined
   332	                out += b"\r\n"
   333	            continue
   334	        out += name
   335	        out += b": "
   336	        out += value
   337	        out += b"\r\n"
   338	
   339	    if trailers is None:
   340	        out += b"content-length: "
   341	        out += str(len(content)).encode("ascii")
   342	        out += b"\r\n\r\n"
   343	        out += content
   344	    else:
   345	        out += b"transfer-encoding: chunked\r\n"
   346	        if trailers:
   347	            announced = []
   348	            seen = set()
   349	            for name, _value in trailers:
   350	                if name not in seen:
   351	                    seen.add(name)
   352	                    announced.append(name)
   353	            out += b"trailer: "
   354	            out += b", ".join(announced)
   355	            out += b"\r\n"
   356	        out += b"\r\n"
   357	        if content:
   358	            out += format(len(content), "x").encode("ascii")
   359	            out += b"\r\n"
   360	            out += content
   361	            out += b"\r\n"
   362	        out += b"0\r\n"
   363	        for name, value in trailers:
   364	            out += name
   365	            out += b": "
   366	            out += value
   367	            out += b"\r\n"
   368	        out += b"\r\n"
   369	    return bytes(out)
   370	
   371	
   372	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   373	# stream machinery
   374	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   375	
   376	def blank_record(sid, status):
   377	    return {"sid": sid, "status": status, "commit_at": None, "origin": None,
   378	            "offset": None, "length": 0, "cache_key": None}
   379	
   380	
   381	def octets(text):
   382	    """Latin-1 octets for a JSON field string, or None when out of range."""
   383	    if not isinstance(text, str):
   384	        return None
   385	    try:
   386	        return text.encode("latin-1")
   387	    except UnicodeEncodeError:
   388	        return None
   389	
   390	
   391	def build_request(state, routes):
   392	    summary = parse_initial(state["initial"])
   393	    if summary is None:
   394	        return None
   395	    content = bytes(state["content"])
   396	    if len(content) > MAX_CONTENT:
   397	        return None
   398	    cl = summary["cl"]
   399	    if cl is not None and cl != digits_norm(b"%d" % len(content)):
   400	        return None
   401	    if state["trailing"] is not None:
   402	        if parse_trailers(state["trailing"]) is None:
   403	            return None
   404	    route_key = summary["scheme"] + "://" + summary["canon"]
   405	    origin = routes.get(route_key)
   406	    if origin is None:
   407	        return None
   408	    cache_key = [summary["method"].decode("ascii"), summary["scheme"],
   409	                 summary["canon"], summary["path"].decode("latin-1")]
   410	    return origin, serialize(summary, content, state["trailing"]), cache_key
   411	
   412	
   413	def finalize(sid, state, commit_at, routes, pipelines):
   414	    record = blank_record(sid, "rejected")
   415	    if state["bad"] or state["initial"] is None:
   416	        return record
   417	    built = build_request(state, routes)
   418	    if built is None:
   419	        return record
   420	    origin, raw, cache_key = built
   421	    pipeline = pipelines[origin]
   422	    record["status"] = "forwarded"
   423	    record["commit_at"] = commit_at
   424	    record["origin"] = origin
   425	    record["offset"] = len(pipeline)
   426	    record["length"] = len(raw)
   427	    record["cache_key"] = cache_key
   428	    pipeline += raw
   429	    return record
   430	
   431	
   432	def run(scenario):
   433	    routes = scenario.get("routes") or {}
   434	    events = scenario.get("events") or []
   435	
   436	    pipelines = {}
   437	    for label in routes.values():
   438	        if label not in pipelines:
   439	            pipelines[label] = bytearray()
   440	
   441	    streams = {}
   442	    results = {}
   443	
   444	    for index, event in enumerate(events):
   445	        sid = event["sid"]
   446	        state = streams.get(sid)
   447	        if state is None:
   448	            state = {"initial": None, "trailing": None, "content": bytearray(),
   449	                     "bad": False, "done": False}
   450	            streams[sid] = state
   451	        if state["done"]:
   452	            continue
   453	
   454	        kind = event["type"]
   455	        if kind == "unknown":
   456	            continue
   457	        if kind == "headers":
   458	            pairs = []
   459	            healthy = True
   460	            for pair in event["fields"]:
   461	                name = octets(pair[0])
   462	                value = octets(pair[1])
   463	                if name is None or value is None:
   464	                    healthy = False
   465	                    name = b"" if name is None else name
   466	                    value = b"" if value is None else value
   467	                pairs.append((name, value))
   468	            if not healthy:
   469	                state["bad"] = True
   470	            if state["initial"] is None:
   471	                state["initial"] = pairs
   472	            elif state["trailing"] is None:
   473	                state["trailing"] = pairs
   474	            else:
   475	                state["bad"] = True
   476	        elif kind == "data":
   477	            blob = event["hex"]
   478	            if isinstance(blob, str):
   479	                try:
   480	                    state["content"] += bytes.fromhex(blob)
   481	                except ValueError:
   482	                    state["bad"] = True
   483	            else:
   484	                state["bad"] = True
   485	            if state["initial"] is None or state["trailing"] is not None:
   486	                state["bad"] = True
   487	        elif kind == "reset":
   488	            state["done"] = True
   489	            results[sid] = blank_record(sid, "cancelled")
   490	        elif kind == "fin":
   491	            state["done"] = True
   492	            results[sid] = finalize(sid, state, index, routes, pipelines)
   493	
   494	    for sid, state in streams.items():
   495	        if not state["done"]:
   496	            results[sid] = blank_record(sid, "incomplete")
   497	
   498	    return {
   499	        "streams": [results[sid] for sid in sorted(results)],
   500	        "origins": {label: bytes(pipe).hex() for label, pipe in pipelines.items()},
   501	    }
   502	
   503	
   504	def main():
   505	    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
   506	    scenario = json.loads(data.decode("utf-8"))
   507	    result = run(scenario)
   508	    json.dump(result, sys.stdout, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":"))
   509	    sys.stdout.write("\n")
   510	
   511	
   512	if __name__ == "__main__":
   513	    main()
